paite: Pathian min leh athuhilhna thu gensiat a a-omlouhna ding in sikha hakkol bat peuhmahte'n amau pute bangkim ah zahtak tham in sim uhen.
heading: Sikhate
english: Let as many as are bondservants under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honor, that the name of God and the doctrine not be blasphemed.

paite: Huan gingtami pu a neite'n unau ahih ziak un ngaineu kei uhen, himahleh phattuamna mute leh deihtakte ahih ziak un a-nna uh sepsak semsem uhen. Huai thute hilh inla, hanthawn in.
english: Those who have believing masters, let them not despise them because they are brothers, but rather let them serve them, because those who partake of the benefit are believing and beloved. Teach and exhort these things.

paite: Mi kuapeuh in thuhilhna dang ahilh a, thutak, i Toupa Jesu Khrist thu leh Pathian limsak lam thuhilhna hoih asak keileh,
heading: Sinsaktu Dikloute
english: If anyone teaches a different doctrine and doesn’t consent to sound words, the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness,

paite: amah kisathei ahi a, bangmah thei lou ahi, theih nak sang in kisel leh thukalh lam ah ahai zawta a, huchibang a kipan in, enna, kilaina, gensiatna,
english: he is conceited, knowing nothing, but obsessed with arguments, disputes, and word battles, from which come envy, strife, insulting, evil suspicions,

paite: hoih lou lam a ginna, selhatna asuak nak hi; huchibang mi lungsim sia neite'n thutak nei lou in, Pathian limsak pen punna khattou asa uhi.
english: constant friction of people of corrupt minds and destitute of the truth, who suppose that godliness is a means of gain. Withdraw yourself from such.

paite: Himahleh lungkimna toh kithuah Pathian limsakna tuh punna thupitak ahi.
heading: Hauhsakna Dik
english: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

paite: Khovel ah bangmah i lutpih kei a, bangmah i pawtpih thei sam kei ding hi.
english: For we brought nothing into the world, and we certainly can’t carry anything out.

paite: Himahleh nek ding leh silh ding nei in, huaite ah i lungkim ding uhi.
english: But having food and clothing, we will be content with that.

paite: Himahleh, hauhsak tumte khemna, thang, haihuai leh hihse thei duhgawlna tampi ah apuklut nak uhi, huaite'n tuh siatna leh manthatna ah mite ahihtum nak uhi.
english: But those who are determined to be rich fall into a temptation, a snare, and many foolish and harmful lusts, such as drown men in ruin and destruction.

paite: Dangka sum deihtak zaw gilou chiteng bul ahi; khenkhatte'n a-eng ua, ginna apaimangsan ua, amau leh amau lungkhamna tampi in akisunlet tektok uhi.
english: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil. Some have been led astray from the faith in their greed, and have pierced themselves through with many sorrows.

paite: Himahleh nang Pathian mipa aw, huai thilte taisan inla, diktatna, Pathian limsakna, ginna, itna, thuaktheihna, kingaihniamnate delh in.
heading: Mimal Kihilhnate
english: But you, man of God, flee these things, and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and gentleness.

paite: Ginna kidouna hoih dou inla, tangtawn hinna len tinten in; huai tang ding a sap na hi a; theihpih tamtakte mitmuh in gupna hoih na gumta hi.
english: Fight the good fight of faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called, and you confessed the good confession in the sight of many witnesses.

paite: Pathian thil bangkim hihhingpa leh Khrist Jesu, Pontias Pilat mai a gupna hoih gumpa mitmuh in thu ka hon pia hi;
english: I command you before God who gives life to all things, and before Christ Jesus who before Pontius Pilate testified the good confession,

paite: Toupa Jesu Khrist hong kilat nawn masiah huai thupiak siangthou leh gensiatbei a kem ding in.
english: that you keep the commandment without spot, blameless until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ,

paite: Huai kilakna ama huntak ah phat tuak thuneipa tak kia, kumpipate' Kumpipa, toupate' Toupa'n alak ding ahi.
english: which at the right time he will show, who is the blessed and only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords.

paite: Amah kia in sih theihlouhna anei a, vak naih theih vual louh ah a-om a, amah kuamah in amu ngei kei ua, muh leng amu thei sam kei uhi; amah kiang ah tangtawn in thupina leh thilhihtheihna om hen, Amen.
english: He alone has immortality, dwelling in unapproachable light, whom no man has seen nor can see, to whom be honor and eternal power. Amen.

paite: Hiai khovel a mihausate kisathei lou ding leh hauhna kip lou a muanna nga lou a, thil tengteng kipahna ding a tampi a hon pepa Pathian a nga zaw ding in hilh in.
english: Charge those who are rich in this present age that they not be arrogant, nor have their hope set on the uncertainty of riches, but on the living God, who richly provides us with everything to enjoy;

paite: Thil hoih ahih ding uh, thil hoih hih a ahauh ding uh, thilphal a asiam ding uh ahi.
english: that they do good, that they be rich in good works, that they be ready to distribute, willing to share;

paite: Huchi a amau a ding a gou kikhol a, tunung a dia suangphum hoih phum a, tangtawn hinna taktak aletkip theihna ding un.
english: laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold of eternal life.

paite: Timothi aw, na kiang a kepsak a om kemhoih in; Pathian zah louh thugen mawkmawk leh kikalhna dikloupi a pilna kichite nungngatsan in;
english: Timothy, guard that which is committed to you, turning away from the empty chatter and oppositions of what is falsely called knowledge,

paite: mi khenkhat in huai nei kichi in ginna ah apaikhial uhi. Hehpihna na kiang ah om hen, Amen.
english: which some profess, and thus have wandered from the faith. Grace be with you. Amen.
